title: Dark mode redesign on claude.ai/code feels like a regression prefer the previous version (or something else)
body: ### Preflight Checklist - [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet - [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features) ### Problem Statement After the recent update to claude.ai/code (desktop), the dark mode redesign doesn't feel right. The combination of a pure black background with bright blue user message bubbles and blue accent text looks dated and harsh, like something from an older UI era. It feels like a noticeable downgrade from the previous version, which felt more polished and modern. What changed: Background is now solid black instead of the more refined dark gray tones from before. User messages are rendered as saturated blue bubbles that clash with the rest of the UI. Overall the interface reads as less premium than the previous dark theme. What worked before: The previous dark theme had softer, layered grays and muted accents. Reading long threads was easier on the eyes and the UI felt cohesive. Environment: Surface: claude.ai/code (desktop) Theme: Dark mode OS: Windows 11 Request: Please either revert to the previous dark mode styling or give users the option to choose between the old and new themes (or a better theme). Screenshot below. ### Proposed Solution Please either revert to the previous dark mode styling or give users the option to choose between the old and new themes (or a better theme). Screenshot below. ### Alternative Solutions Please either revert to the previous dark mode styling or give users the option to choose between the old and new themes (or a better theme). top_comments.author: anton-velko
top_comments.body: It's become incredibly unpleasant to work with the software after this redesign. Seriously, bring back the old one or give me a choice or something.

top_comments.author: CoRe23cz
top_comments.body:
This feels like a step back. The new theme is harder to read — the previous dark theme had better colors, including a warm orange-brown highlight for inline code blocks. Please consider adding an option to revert to the old style.
Observed in: Claude Windows desktop app, Code tab.

top_comments.author: danieljclark
top_comments.body: Yes agreed, I'm new to Claude Code and thought I'd accidentally changed a hidden theme setting!  Really don't like the new look at all, far too harsh and offputting.
